decisions.why: the division holds exactly two products and they belong to two different categories - Natural Maternity Pads (post-natal maternity pads, womens:mat) and Natural Nursing Pads (breast pads worn while breastfeeding, womens:feed). Lou's rule of 25/08/2026 applies: a division whose own evidence names products from more than one category goes in all of them rather than being forced into one. Read from the company's own site structure (natracare.com, Bodywise (UK) Ltd's own brand site) by scripts/crawl_supplier_site.py on 05/09/2026
